title: Closed points, transcendence degree, support
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and $X$ a scheme over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphism is of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. A point $x\in X$ is *closed* if $\{x\}$ is closed in the underlying topological space of $X$ [def-weil-closed-points]. The residue field $\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is a field extension of $K$ through the structure morphism; write

$$
\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(x)
$$

for its transcendence degree over $K$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], and for an integer $a\ge0$ set

$$
E_a(X)=\{x\in X:\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(x)\le a\}.
$$

For an etale sheaf of abelian groups $F\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the *support* $\kunsupp F$ is the set of $x\in X$ such that $F_{\bar x}\ne0$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] for some geometric point $\bar x$ of $X$ lying over $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point]; that this set does not depend on the choice of the geometric point over $x$ is [lem-kun-support-geometric-point-independent], which the definition does not use. For $K\in D(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] put

$$
\kunsupp K=\bigcup_{q\in\mathbf Z}\kunsupp\mathcal H^q(K),
$$

using the cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^q(K)\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint (no slopmaster2 copy, no Lean on either branch). Named the notions it is built from as statement dependencies: scheme over K and finite type (def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, Mathlib leaves), closed points (def-weil-closed-points, leaf), residue field with its K-structure (def-weil-residue-field, leaf), transcendence degree (new leaf def-kun-transcendence-degree, Algebra.trdeg), etale abelian sheaves, geometric points, geometric stalks, derived category and cohomology sheaves (def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories). Dropped def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions: the statement only needs 'finite type over a field', and its parenthetical claim that X is Noetherian, quasi-compact and quasi-separated is a property not used by the definitions, so it was removed from the text. Replaced '{x} closed in |X|' by 'closed in the underlying space' because def-weil-closed-points uses |X| for the set of closed points. The independence of the geometric point is pointed to as lem-kun-support-geometric-point-independent but is not a dependency (the definition uses 'some geometric point', and that lemma depends on this node). Searched Mathlib for a support of sheaves on a site/etale site: none (only Module.support and ideal-sheaf support).

lean.statement: def etaleSheafSupport {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) : Set X
lean.note: The three new definitions are E_a(X), support of an abelian etale sheaf, and support of a derived abelian etale sheaf. Closed points and transcendence degree reuse closedPoints and Algebra.trdeg. The support constructions need no finite-type or base-field arguments; their restriction to the schemes of the node is exactly the stated support.
